unlisted_practices: Integrate values clarification exercises into nursing curricula early so students can critically evaluate the ethical implications of AI and align its use with patient-centered care.
Equip nursing students with data literacy, cyberethics, and skills to evaluate the ethical implications of AI implementation.
Use case-based learning, virtual reality simulation, group projects, and reflective writing exercises to teach nursing students the ethical use of AI.
Ensure values clarification exercises are combined with evidence-based practice and do not prioritize personal beliefs over scientific evidence.
Provide professional development and evidence-based resources so nurse educators can facilitate values clarification safely and avoid bias or indoctrination.
Conduct rigorous evaluations of the effectiveness of values clarification for AI integration in nursing education.

screen.reason: This is an educational commentary/perspective article discussing strategies for integrating values clarification into nursing education to ethically prepare students for AI.
